name: Binary-choice participation card
description: Invite a clear A/B response without pretending an MP4 is interactive. Builds an editable 10-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: Two understandable choices can invite a meaningful response.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 10 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: One context image and one short question.
Both choices use the same treatment, so give them images of the same kind.

props.label: Compare prompt
props.hint: Shows with both choices side by side.

props.subtitle: Tell viewers exactly how to answer.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Binary-choice participation card
value.objective: Invite a clear A/B response without pretending an MP4 is interactive.
value.direction: The two choices have equal visual weight and remain visible long enough to answer.
beats: 0–2 s: Context image and one short question. Shows Brand color, Context image, Question.
2–4 s: Left/top card appears with a simple visual. Shows Brand color, Choice A, Choice A text.
4–6 s: Right/bottom card appears in the matching treatment. Shows Brand color, Choice B, Choice B text.
6–8 s: Both choices are shown together. Shows Brand color, Choice A, Choice B, Compare prompt.
8–10 s: Explicit instruction: comment A/B, or use a configured native poll. Shows Brand color, Choice A, Choice B, Logo, Participation call to action.

images.label: Context image
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Context image and one short question.

images.label: Choice A
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Left/top card appears with a simple visual. | Both choices are shown together. | Explicit instruction: comment A/B, or use a configured native poll.

images.label: Choice B
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Right/bottom card appears in the matching treatment. | Both choices are shown together. | Explicit instruction: comment A/B, or use a configured native poll.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Explicit instruction: comment A/B, or use a configured native poll.
